Name: NPC Yoba - New portraits and sprites
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
What it says on the tin!
Adds new portraits and sprites done by me to the Yoba NPC by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56408012]jeremy0709[/url].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI, Yoba and everything else needed for Yoba.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
